info.title: Citebase: get cited by AI
info.description: Plain-language SEO and get-recommended-by-AI helper. Start with POST /run using tool get_playbook and name start, then follow it. Free. Saves nothing unless you give a project name; then it saves in your own Apify account.

post.summary: Run one Citebase tool (use this one)
post.description: Runs one free Citebase tool and returns JSON {ok, tool, result}. First call: body {"tool":"get_playbook","arguments":{"name":"start"}} and follow that playbook. Tools and their arguments: get_playbook {name?} lists or reads guidelines; audit_site {url, max_pages?} checks a public website; quote_cost {items:[{job,units,requests?}]} prices paid data jobs and returns suggested_cap_usd; measure_recommendation_share {panel,runs,baseline?,current?,experiments?} or {project} computes how often AI recommends the brand; next_steps {audit?,report?,max_steps?} makes a plain to-do list; check_outreach_draft {to,subject,body,suppressed?,sent_today?,daily_cap?} checks an email and never sends; save_results {project, runs?, panel?, brand?, audit?, append?, replace?} saves progress under a project name; get_history {project} shows progress over time; make_report {project} makes a shareable one-page report link; import_ai_results {project, items, snapshot, save?} converts AI Brand Monitor results; schedule_checks {project, url, frequency?} gives steps and costs for automatic re-checks; scheduled_check {project, url, max_pages?} is the site check plus report refresh meant for an Apify Schedule. true/false fields must be real booleans. Errors return {ok:false,error} with what to fix. Nothing is saved unless a project name is given; saved data stays in the caller's own Apify account.

tool.description: Which Citebase tool to run, for example get_playbook. NOT an Apify Actor name.

arguments.description: Inputs for the chosen tool as JSON, for example {"name":"start"} or {"url":"https://example.com"}. Defaults to {}. Never put passwords or tokens here.

400.description: Bad input; the error says what to fix
